what_it_does: Polycab India Limited manufactures and sells cables, wires, and fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG) and executes engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) projects. It serves retail, industrial, and institutional customers, generating revenue through product sales and project execution.
other_facts: Export revenues reached 15,695 Mn across 94 geographies in FY26.
The FMEG division has over 2,900 dealers and distributors pan-India.
The company has over 190,000 retail touchpoints across India.
